skill.name: Void Surge
skill.description: Bel'Veth dashes in a chosen direction and damages all enemies she passes through.

skill.name: Above and Below
skill.description: Bel'Veth slams her tail to the ground, damaging, knocking up, and slowing her enemies.

skill.name: Royal Maelstrom
skill.description: Bel'Veth roots herself in place, channeling a storm of slashes around her that targets the lowest-health enemy and grants her lifesteal and damage reduction.

passive.name: Death in Lavender
passive.description: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions. She also gains temporary bonus attack speed after using an ability.

skill.name: Endless Banquet
skill.description: Bel'Veth consumes Void coral remnants, transforming into her true form and increasing her max health, attack range, and attack speed. Consuming the Void coral remnants of a Void epic monster will grant her the power to summon Void remora.

skill.name: Death's Grasp
skill.description: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

skill.name: Realm of Death
skill.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

skill.name: Hounds' Pursuit
skill.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.

skill.name: The Call of the Pack
skill.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.

skill.name: Chain Lash
skill.description:
Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies.

After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

skill.name: Thundering Smash
skill.description: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, <status>Stunning</status> and damaging the first one he Attacks.

skill.name: Elastic Slingshot
skill.description: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

passive.name: Second Skin
passive.description: Kai'Sa's basic attacks stack Plasma, dealing increasing bonus magic damage. Allies' immobilizing effects help stack Plasma. Additionally, Kai'Sa's item purchases upgrade her basic spells to have more powerful properties.

skill.name: Ritual Nails
skill.description: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.

skill.name: Soul Ignition
skill.description: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.

skill.name: Bramble Smash
skill.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

skill.name: Blade of the Exile
skill.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

skill.name: Wind Slash
skill.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.
